items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: He was working with, I think he was working with Sidney Desvign band then.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was around that time, he used to do writing, you know, nice band too, banjo band. He was working with, I think he was working with Sidney Desvign band then. Who was there? Sales, I think he was, he was playing at the roof garden often. Uh-huh.
You didn't have Judge Gaynor in that band?
